title: Foundation, Conductor and toolchain — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Static foundation, toolchain pin, and inheritance contracts verified; live upstream registration in edithatogo/repository-standards and external estate conformance remain open operational gates.

synthesized_findings: The multidisciplinary expert evaluation panel reached unanimous consensus approving Track 00 (Foundation, Conductor and toolchain). Across all six acceptance assertions (T00-A001 through T00-A006), the foundation assets demonstrate uncompromising architectural rigor, deterministic reproducibility, and strict boundary enforcement. Upstream Conductor baseline 0.3.0 is locked in conductor/upstream.lock.json and paired with reproducible shell/PowerShell installers. The linked context documentation spine (index, product, guidelines, stack, workflow, requirements, design) resolves cleanly under context integrity checking. The native v3 status adapter (scripts/conductor_status.py) operates strictly read-only, passing exhaustive adversarial test suites in tests/test_conductor_status.py without executing inspected-root code. In rust-toolchain.toml, the Rust channel is strictly locked to 1.97.1 stable with MSRV and experimental policies clearly articulated. Cargo.lock is committed with workspace resolver 3 and Rust edition 2024, verified via scripts/check_rust_dependency_graph.py. Tool manifests covering 11 pinned cargo tools and 57 static verification gates in scripts/run_static_harness.py enforce continuous repository integrity network-free. Repository standards inheritance is codified in integration/passports/repository-standards-inheritance.json, accompanied by a fail-closed companion packet enforcing remote_mutation_permitted: false. Upstream registration in edithatogo/repository-standards and external estate scanner execution are properly preserved as open operational gates rather than prematurely claimed. All 6 governance unit tests in tests/test_foundation_toolchain_governance.py pass 100% network-free.
